security.note: Server is open. Set --auth-token / AIPOD_API_KEY(S) to require a bearer token.

authentication.note: None. The server accepts unauthenticated requests.

sampling.note: Only the pydantic-ai tools need sampling; every other feature works without it.

dataEgress.note: The sampling tools forward prompt content to the connected client's model. No other tool makes outbound calls.

tools.name: echo
tools.title: Echo
tools.description: Echo the input message back to the caller.

tools.name: add
tools.title: Add
tools.description: Add two numbers and describe the result.

tools.name: get_tiny_image
tools.title: Get tiny image
tools.description: Return text interleaved with an image content block.

tools.name: get_annotated_message
tools.title: Get annotated message
tools.description: Return content blocks carrying priority and audience annotations.

tools.name: get_structured_weather
tools.title: Get structured weather
tools.description: Return a typed Weather object so the client can validate it against the output schema.

outputSchema.description: Structured weather payload returned by the weather tools.
outputSchema.title: Weather

tools.name: get_resource_reference
tools.title: Get resource reference
tools.description: Return an embedded resource content block for a dynamic resource.

tools.name: get_resource_links
tools.title: Get resource links
tools.description: Return between 1 and 10 resource_link blocks pointing at dynamic resources.

tools.name: trigger_long_running_operation
tools.title: Trigger long running operation
tools.description: Run a fake multi-step job, emitting a progress notification per step.

tools.name: toggle_simulated_logging
tools.title: Toggle simulated logging
tools.description: Start or stop a background task that emits a random-level log message every 5s.

tools.name: toggle_subscriber_updates
tools.title: Toggle subscriber updates
tools.description: Start or stop a background task that emits resources/updated for every subscribed resource.

tools.name: poet
tools.title: Poet (pydantic-ai + sampling)
tools.description: A pydantic-ai agent writes a short rhyming poem; the LLM comes from the client via MCP sampling.

tools.name: summarize
tools.title: Summarize (pydantic-ai structured output + sampling)
tools.description: A pydantic-ai agent returns a structured Summary; the LLM comes from the client via MCP sampling.

outputSchema.description: Structured result produced by the `summarize` tool.

headline.description: A single sentence capturing the gist
headline.title: Headline

outputSchema.title: Summary

tools.name: weather_report
tools.title: Weather report (pydantic-ai + sampling)
tools.description: A pydantic-ai agent turns the structured readings for a city into a short spoken-style forecast.

tools.name: list_heroes
tools.title: List heroes
tools.description: List the Marvel heroes in the roster, optionally filtered by team.

codename.description: The hero's public alias, lower-case-slug form (e.g. 'spider-man')
codename.title: Codename

first_appearance.description: Year the character first appeared in print
first_appearance.title: First Appearance

outputSchema.description: A list of heroes plus its length, returned by the listing / search tools.
outputSchema.title: HeroRoster

tools.name: get_hero
tools.title: Get hero
tools.description: Return the full record for one hero by codename (e.g. 'spider-man').

codename.description: The hero's public alias, lower-case-slug form (e.g. 'spider-man')
codename.title: Codename

first_appearance.description: Year the character first appeared in print
first_appearance.title: First Appearance

tools.name: find_heroes_by_power
tools.title: Find heroes by power
tools.description: Return every hero whose power list matches the given substring (e.g. 'flight').

codename.description: The hero's public alias, lower-case-slug form (e.g. 'spider-man')
codename.title: Codename

first_appearance.description: Year the character first appeared in print
first_appearance.title: First Appearance

outputSchema.description: A list of heroes plus its length, returned by the listing / search tools.
outputSchema.title: HeroRoster

tools.name: assemble_team
tools.title: Assemble team
tools.description: Pick the heroes whose powers best fit a described threat (deterministic).

reason.description: Why this hero fits the stated threat
reason.title: Reason

tools.name: hero_bio
tools.title: Hero bio (pydantic-ai + sampling)
tools.description: A pydantic-ai agent writes a short in-universe bio from the hero's facts; the LLM comes from the client via MCP sampling.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the application/service catalogue, optionally filtered by tier or environment.

Service.description: One application / service in the catalogue.
Service.title: Service

tools.name: get_service
tools.title: Get service
tools.description: Return one service's catalogue entry: tier, team, dependencies, SLOs, repo.

outputSchema.description: One application / service in the catalogue.
outputSchema.title: Service

tools.name: check_service_health
tools.title: Check service health
tools.description: Roll up synthetic metrics, SLOs, and open incidents into a healthy/degraded/down verdict.

tools.name: error_budget
tools.title: Error budget
tools.description: Compute the remaining SLO error budget and current burn rate for a service.

budget_minutes.description: Total downtime allowed in the window
budget_minutes.title: Budget Minutes

burn_rate.description: Multiples of the sustainable rate; >1 is too fast
burn_rate.title: Burn Rate

tools.name: search_logs
tools.title: Search logs
tools.description: Search a service's (synthetic, deterministic) log stream for a substring, optionally by level.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: List incidents, optionally filtered by status, severity, or service.

tools.name: open_incident
tools.title: Open incident
tools.description: Open a new incident against a service. Mutates server-side state.

tools.name: update_incident
tools.title: Update incident
tools.description: Move an incident to a new status (acknowledged/mitigated/resolved) with an optional note. Mutates state.

tools.name: get_oncall
tools.title: Get on-call
tools.description: Who is on call for a team or for the team that owns a service, plus the escalation order.

escalation.description: Who to page next, in order
escalation.title: Escalation

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.title: List deployments
tools.description: List recent deployments, optionally filtered by service or status.

tools.name: rollback_deployment
tools.title: Roll back deployment
tools.description: Roll back a deployment by id (simulated). Mutates server-side state.

tools.name: get_runbook
tools.title: Get runbook
tools.description: Return the runbook entries for a service, optionally narrowed to a symptom.

tools.name: incident_postmortem
tools.title: Incident postmortem (pydantic-ai + sampling)
tools.description: A pydantic-ai agent drafts a short blameless postmortem from an incident's facts; the LLM comes from the client via MCP sampling.
